newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -AB Foods shares in decline to 450p.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -AB Foods shares in decline to 450p.

text.p: DAY'S RANGE * SUPPORT * RESTNCE* MA-25 * MA-200
+ Shares in Associated British Foods are losing momentum and could slip back to 450p, technical analysts said.

+ The shares have been suffering increased volatility and erosion relative to the All-Share index following a doubling of the share price since 1995 -- and this signals deteriorating conditions for the shares, they added.
Shares in food manufacturer Associated British Foods are in danger of losing their way and may slip back, technical analysts said.
The shares have doubled in value since 1995 so may be due a rest but the unusually large price swings which the shares have endured since March gives warning of deteriorating conditions, they added.

"While not a classic top pattern, the stock appears to have topped out in price and relative terms and a setback to around 450p looks possible," said Richard Lake, technical analyst at Brewin Dolphin & Co.
"After such a good price and relative rise (against the All-Share index) an increase in volatility is normally a good warning sign to be cautious," added Lake.
By 1000 GMT, shares of AB Foods were down 7p to 545p.
The shares peaked this year at 577p on June 17 before plunging to 512p within a week and then managed to stagger back up to 562p until this latest bout of weakness.
Such rapid swings have left the stock's 25-day moving average drifting lower and indicates a weak underlying trend.
Confirming this trend is a chart of the share price relative to the All-Share index which has been in general decline since March losing 11 percent relative to the index since that time.

Although there has been a slight pick-up in the shares' relative strength recently this is beginning to fade so the chances are that the share price will once again come under pressure, analysts said.
